subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support explicit cookie re-import as a public CLI recovery workflow, and should the supported scope remain aligned with the separate in-app settings recovery surface?
rationale: This is a new user-facing credential-recovery capability, not a repair to an established CLI contract; the right permanent command shape and supported provider scope require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Sponsor explicit CLI recovery
options.body: Approve the provider-metadata-based CLI command as an intentional opt-in recovery surface after real signed-app and terminal proof is supplied.

options.title: Prefer in-app recovery only
options.body: Keep cookie refresh behind the settings workflow and close or narrow the CLI feature to avoid exposing a second public recovery contract.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause both recovery surfaces until a maintainer defines the intended provider, automation, and account-switch support policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor explicit CLI recovery
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-metadata-based CLI command as an intentional opt-in recovery surface after real signed-app and terminal proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: Current implementation and the Keychain-gating follow-up are authored by steipete, making this the strongest available routing signal for the CLI contract.
